headline: Pakistan has invited international bids for two LNG cargoes for December and January as Qatari supply disruptions threaten winter shortages, with spot prices around $33 per MMBTU against about $14 under the Qatar deals, Arab News reports.

card.desc: Spot LNG taqreeban $33 fi MMBTU, Qatar deal mein $14 tha

caption:
Sardiyon se pehle gas ki qillat ka khatra!
Arab News ke mutabiq petroleum ministry ke ek senior afsar ne Thursday ko bataya ke Pakistan ne December aur January ke liye 2 LNG cargoes ke international bids talab kiye hain, jo Friday tak jama honge. Qatar ki supply mein rukawat ke baad spot LNG taqreeban $33 fi MMBTU tak pohanch gayi hai, jabke Qatar ke muahide mein Pakistan taqreeban $14 de raha tha.
Kya aap ke ghar mein gas poori aa rahi hai? Comment mein batayein 👇
